MGA Fivers Wien - Atzgersdorf

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. Being a champion of England is a goal that weighs every player of the Premier League. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy / Made in Italy - Champions of Italy
programme.desc: The largest League competition in Italy was founded in 1898. Twenty clubs are struggled every year for the prestigious title of Champions series A. / Najveće ligaško takmičenje u Italiji osnovano je 1898 godine. Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: Made in Italy - Champions of Italy / Made in Italy - Champions of Italy
programme.desc: The largest League competition in Italy was founded in 1898. Twenty clubs are struggled every year for the prestigious title of Champions series A. / Najveće ligaško takmičenje u Italiji osnovano je 1898 godine. Dvadeset klubova se svake godine bori za prestižnu titulu prvaka Serije A.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: LaLiga Talking Football / LaLiga Talking Football
programme.desc: Interesting talks with current and former participants in the highest, Spanish, football league. They talk about their experiences, opinion and unforgettable time spent in the game. / Interesantni razgovori sa sadašnjim i bivšim učesnicima najviše, španske, fudbalske lige. Oni pričaju o svojim iskustvima, mišljenju i nezaboravnom vremenu provedenom u igri.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. With the dominant Russian clubs in the league, clubs from Bijelarus, Estonia, Kazakh and Latvia are also attended. Through the history of the League launched in 2008. More clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting from the season 2013-204. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, from which the champion of Russia becomes best. In order for clubs to access the league must have a minimum capacity hall for 3000 viewers. The name of the VTB league comes from the General Sponsor of the League of the VTB Bank. FIBA Europe is 2013 officially recognized the league. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. As a continuation of the English League founded back in 1888. The season lasts to May in the two-circular system where each team plays 38 games. The first winter of the championship is the most trophy English football club, Manchester United. programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League / Košarka - Turska liga
programme.desc: The very beginnings of the Turkish basketball take far before the league of 1966. Years. Ear even early 20. The centuries of hoops under the hoops were known in Turkey. Students with Rober College in Istanbul in 1904. They first discovered the charms of this team sport. The first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs started the year after the founding of the league. The second league was launched three years later. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that plays each with every twice in the regular part after which the play-of eight of the best teams follows. The two weakest placed teams fall out of the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko prije osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plej-of osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian League / Košarka - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The highest Division of the Italian basketball championship. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.desc: Extreme is an off -road race with electric jeeps, which takes place in remote places in the world like the tropical forests of the Amazon. programme.desc: The Tour of Croatia is one of the most significant events in cycling that attracts world professional teams and is part of the European Calendar of the UCI. The tour offers exciting stages that go through some of the most beautiful landscapes of Croatia-from the Adriatic coast to the interior of the country. / Обиколката на Хърватия (Tour of Croatia) е едно от най-значимите събития в колоезденето, което привлича световни професионални отбори и е част от Европейския календар на UCI. Турът предлага вълнуващи етапи, които преминават през някои от най-красивите пейзажи на Хърватия — от Адриатическото крайбрежие до вътрешността на страната.

programme.desc: Weekly television broadcast dedicated to Bulgarian tourism. The team travels all over Bulgaria and promotes Bulgarian cities as attractive tourist destinations. Only in our show time stops and you can walk through the captivating and beautiful Bulgarian mountains, to conquer the highest native peaks, to take the steepest forest paths. Get to know us the most challenging tourist routes and immerse yourself in the past with the most exciting historical collections of Bulgaria. / Седмично телевизионно предаване, посветено на българския туризъм. Екипът пътува в цяла България и популяризира български градове като атрактивни туристически дестинации. Само в нашето предаване времето спира и можете да се разхождате из пленителните и красиви български планини, да покорите най-високите родни върхове, да превземете най-стръмните горски пътеки. Опознайте с нас най- предизвикателните туристически маршрути и се потопете в миналото с най-вълнуващите исторически сбирки на България.

programme.title: Through the Time Corridors with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: Represented by Morgan Freeman, the series "Through the Corridors of Time" explores the greatest mysteries of our existence - issues that puzzles humanity from all over eternity. Questions that have been reflected in the most sophisticated minds of the human race. Today, science has evolved to a stage where specific facts and evidence may provide us with answers, displacing philosophical theories. "Through the corridors of time" brings together brilliant thinkers and magnificent ideas from different fields of science - astrophysics, astrobiology, quantum mechanics, string theory, and others to reveal the amazing truth about our universe. / Представена от Морган Фрийман, поредицата "През коридорите на времето" изследва най-големите мистерии на съществуването ни - въпросите, озадачаващи човечеството от цяла вечност. Въпроси, върху които са размишлявали най-изтънчените умове на човешкия род. Днес науката се е развила до етап, при който конкретните факти и доказателства може би ще ни предоставят отговорите, измествайки философските теории. "През коридорите на времето" събира блестящи мислители и великолепни идеи от различни сфери на науката - астрофизиката, астробиологията, квантовата механика, струнната теория и други, за да ни разкрие удивителната истина за нашата Вселена.

The latter wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "The Last Win" is a fun-cognitive, family quiz show involving four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. After the end of each round, one participant drops out, and the winner wins the right to compete in the next episode and plays until someone else is able to beat him. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.desc: In the electricity show "You have a meeting ... with Diana Lyubenova" there will be celebrities from the world of art, culture, music, theater, journalism, sports and not only. All of them will reveal to Diana Lyubenova and public television viewers their dreams, they will share the path to success, the good and difficult times in their lives, the priceless friendships and the people they can always rely on. / В ток шоуто "Имате среща... с Диана Любенова" ще гостуват известни личности от света на изкуството, културата, музиката, театъра, журналистиката, спорта и не само. Всички те ще разкриват пред Диана Любенова и зрителите на обществената телевизия мечтите си, ще споделят за пътя към успеха, за хубавите и трудните моменти в живота си, за безценните приятелства и хората, на които винаги могат да разчитат.

programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

Und kaum haben die beiden ein paar Satze gewechselt, kommt es zum ersten Einsatz: Bei der Wohnungsauflosung eines alten Mannes wurden von seiner Tochter menschliche Überreste entdeckt. Schnell stellen Maryam und Hamza fest, dass der Mord schon einige Jahre zuruckliegt - und dass die Handschrift des Taters an andere ungeloste Mordfalle erinnert. Die Hinweise fuhren die beiden zu einem beruchtigten Serienmorder, der ein nahezu perfektes Doppelleben gefuhrt zu haben scheint. Doch als die Medien von dem Fund der Leichenteile erfahren und mit ihrer Berichterstattung die Ermittlung gefahrden, geraten die beiden unter Druck, die Opfer schnellstmoglich zu identifizieren. Ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit und eine Reise in die Vergangenheit Frankfurts beginnt. Maryam und Hamza bleiben drei Tage, um Kriminalakten bis in die 1970er Jahre durchzuarbeiten und trauernden Angehorigen endlich Gewissheit zu geben. Im weiteren Verlauf stoSSen die beiden noch auf ein Opfer, das auf den ersten Blick zwar nicht in das Muster des Serienmorders passt, aber dem Fall eine neue grausame Wendung geben konnte.

programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.title: A Habsburg on Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator and the magic of the sea / Ein Habsburger auf Mallorca - Ludwig Salvator und der Zauber des Meeres
programme.desc: Ludwig Salvator, Archduke of Austria and Prince of Tuscany, traveled and researched the Mediterranean with his sailing yacht for decades and finally settled in Mallorca.* His special interest was the research of unknown islands at the time, from the country and people, flora and fauna. He documented his trips in words and pictures. Magnificent Bucher testify to his universal work.*Archduke Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lorraine and Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) was an unpleasant, a universal genius, an dropout and nature conservationist from the very beginning. However, he was not only a fun -loving globetrotter, but also a recognized researcher of the Mediterranean, especially the Balearic Islands. He has recorded his research results on history, flora and fauna in extensive publications. The documentation shows the most important life stations of Ludwig Salvator and the sustainable effects of his research activity in the late 19th century. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Als Besitzer der Dampfsegelyacht "Nixe" und des "Kapitanspatentes der langen Fahrt" war er jahrzehntelang im Mittelmeer unterwegs, um das Interesse der Öffentlichkeit fur damals weitgehend unbekannte Regionen zu wecken, wie die Liparischen Inseln und die Ionischen Inseln.Die wilde Schonheit der Balearen und die Liebenswurdigkeit von deren Bewohnern beeindruckten den Erzherzog besonders. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Seiner schabigen Kleidung wegen wurde er immer wieder fur einen Schafhirten oder Landarbeiter gehalten - zu seiner groSSen Belustigung. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.title: Julie Andrews - unforgettable Mary Poppins / Julie Andrews - Unvergessene Mary Poppins
programme.desc: If you hear the name Julie Andrews, most probably think of the most extraordinary children's girl of all time: Mary Poppins. It is less known that Andrews, who was born in Walton-on-Thames in 1935, was already a singing talent as a child and celebrated her first success in 1940-in the middle of the air battle for England-in the London subway. Plagued by stage fright and blessed with a voice range of over four octaves, Andrews rose to the favorite of the British Music Halls. In the USA, after her Broadway success, she became a musical star in Hollywood with "My Fair Lady". For her first film role in "Mary Poppins" she received a Golden Globe and an Oscar. Although she was very early in a sussen, asexual image, she also played graceful roles in films by Alfred Hitchcock, Andrej Konchalovsky and Blake Edwards. But despite her many successes, she also had to overwind the big background over the course of her decades of career. The film by Yves Rioou looks at the life of Julie Andrews with a lot of imagination and humor and unfolds a subtle poetry between music, dance and the unmistakable laughter of the actress. / Wenn sie den Namen Julie Andrews horen, denken die meisten wahrscheinlich an das auSSergewohnlichste Kindermadchen aller Zeiten: Mary Poppins. Weniger bekannt ist, dass Andrews, die 1935 in Walton-on-Thames geboren wurde, bereits als Kind ein Gesangstalent war und ihre ersten Erfolge 1940 - inmitten der Luftschlacht um England - in der Londoner U-Bahn feierte. Von Lampenfieber geplagt und mit einem Stimmumfang von uber vier Oktaven gesegnet, stieg Andrews zum Liebling der britischen Music Halls auf.In den USA avancierte sie nach ihrem Broadway-Erfolg mit "My Fair Lady" zum Musical-Star in Hollywood. Throughout his life, he was driven by the desire to travel, understand and preserve. As the owner of the steam yacht "mermaid" and the "capitan spatent of the long journey", he was in the Mediterranean for decades to awaken the interest of the public for the regions that were largely unknown at the time, such as the Liparic Islands and the Ionian protective of the Balearic and the loveliness of their inhabitants particularly impressed the archduke. He created a small paradise in the northwest of Mallorca, where no animal was tired and no tree was allowed to be. For his monumental work "The Balearic Islands. Described in word and picture" he received the gold medal at the Paris World Exhibition in 1889.Annatuigent legends and anecdotes rose around the "uncrowned king of the Balearic Islands". He neither grief about the appearance that was expected by a member of the Habsburg family, nor about what others thought about him. Because of his scraping clothes, he was kept for a shepherd or farm worker - to his great amusement. He commented calmly that he was considered a scholarly nerd at Hof: "Better diverse than simple". Ludwig Salvator's love life was turbulent. The bachelor is said to have been to both sexes and have had countless affarities. He supposedly took care of his illegitimate children. One of his love affairs, Catalina Homar, the daughter of a carpenter, let the Archduke give an excellent training and finally made them the administrator of his vineyard. Ludwig Salvator was a scientist, artist, visionary, pacifist, nature conservation, writer and one of the most dazzling people from Habsburg. / Ludwig Salvator, Erzherzog von Österreich und Prinz von Toskana, bereiste und erforschte jahrzehntelang mit seiner Segelyacht "Nixe" das Mittelmeer und lieSS sich schlieSSlich auf Mallorca nieder.*Er war gebildet, unangepasst und aufgeschlossen. Sein besonderes Interesse galt der Erforschung damals unbekannter Inseln, von Land und Leuten, Flora und Fauna. Seine Reisen dokumentierte er in Wort und Bild. Prachtvolle Bucher bezeugen sein universelles Schaffen.*Erzherzog Ludwig Salvator von Habsburg-Lothringen und Bourbon (4.8.1847-12.10.1915) war ein Unangepasster, ein Universalgenie, ein Aussteiger und Natur-schutzer der ersten Stunde. Er war aber nicht nur ein lebenslustiger Globetrotter, sondern auch ein anerkannter Forscher des Mittelmeerraumes, besonders der Balearen. Seine Forschungsergebnisse uber Geschichte, Tier- und Pflanzenwelt hat er in umfangreichen Publikationen festgehalten.Die Dokumentation zeigt die wichtigsten Lebensstationen Ludwig Salvators und die nachhaltigen Auswirkungen seiner Forschertatigkeit im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert. Zeit seines Lebens war er getrieben von dem Verlangen zu reisen, zu verstehen und zu bewahren. Er schuf sich im Nordwesten Mallorcas ein kleines Paradies, wo kein Tier getotet und kein Baum gefallt werden durfte. Fur sein Monumentalwerk "Die Balearen. Geschildert in Wort und Bild" erhielt er auf der Pariser Weltausstellung 1889 die Goldmedaille.Unzahlige Legenden und Anekdoten ranken sich um den "ungekronten Konig der Balearen". Er kummerte sich weder um das Auftreten, das von einem Mitglied der Familie Habsburg erwartet wurde, noch darum, was andere uber ihn dachten. Dass er bei Hof als gelehrter Sonderling galt, kommentierte er gelassen: "Lieber vielfaltig als einfaltig".Ludwig Salvators Liebesleben war turbulent. Der Junggeselle soll beiden Geschlechtern zugetan gewesen sein und zahllose Affaren gehabt haben. Fur seine unehelichen Kinder hat er angeblich gut gesorgt. Einer seiner Liebschaften, Catalina Homar, der Tochter eines Tischlers, lieSS der Erzherzog eine exzellente Ausbildung angedeihen und machte sie schlieSSlich sogar zur Verwalterin seiner Weinguter.Ludwig Salvator war Wissenschaftler, Kunstler, Visionar, Pazifist, Naturschutzer, Schriftsteller und eine der schillerndsten Personlichkeiten aus dem Hause Habsburg.Eine Dokumentation von Rosa Maria Plattner

programme.title: The Habsburgs in Europe - from the dark of the time / Die Habsburger in Europa - Aus dem Dunkel der Zeit
programme.desc: The multi -part documentary series "Die Habsburg in Europe" is a foray through the European history and the most beautiful and most important acts of the Habsburg.*The House of Habsburg was one of the most influential dynasties and over centuries central designer of European history. In Alsace and Swiss Aargau, the oldest traces of this ruling are found: picturesque castles, monastery and ruins.*The rise of the Habsburgers from a regional German ducal family from today's Elsass to the most powerful ruling dynasty in Europe is also reflected in the many structural certificates that are still reminiscent of their rise and its former power. The starting point of the cinematic journey into those Lander and to those places that are still characterized by the Habsburgs is the Vienna Hofburg. Based on the former center of power of the German-Romic emperors, the journey first leads to west, Alsace and the Swiss canton of Aargau, where the gender of the Habsburgers entered the light of history around 900 years ago. One special importance is still important for the Habsburg monastery in Alsace, where the relics of the Holy Ottilie are kept from the 7th century. The noble woman from the Frankish gender of the Etchons is considered the main mother of her dynasty to the Habsburgs. The ruins of Hohlandsbourg Castle also rises high above the Rhine Valley, which was built for many centuries later on the command of Rudolf von Habsburg. It testifies to the impressive political rise of the Habsburg to a German king dynasty in the 13th century. Rudolf's election to the German King in 1273 meant an enormous increase in power and prestige, which was also manifested in a lively building act. A detour to Suden goes to the Swiss canton of Aargau, where the remains of the Habsburg also rise, which also gave the gender its name. Here the medieval archaologist Peter Frey has been researching the building history of the castle for years, of which only a part has been preserved. As Rudolf once moved to the east, to the Duchy of Austria to defeat his rival Ottokar of Bohmen, the first part of the documentation series follows his traces to Durnkrut, and thus one of the greatest battles of the medieval. The importance of symbols for consolidating power and status in the Middle Ages is also discussed. In the Cathedral of Speyer, Rudolf I was buried next to the German king of Fruher nobility, thus underpinning the new status of his family. The treasury in the Hofburg in Vienna is also visited, where the ReichsinSignia Reichskrone, Schwert and Zepter have been kept for around 200 years. / Die mehrteilige Dokumentationsreihe "Die Habsburger in Europa" ist ein Streifzug durch die europaische Geschichte und zu den schonsten und bedeutendsten Wirkstatten der Habsburger.*Das Haus Habsburg war eine der einflussreichsten Dynastien und uber Jahrhunderte hinweg zentraler Gestalter der europaischen Geschichte. Im Elsass und im Schweizer Aargau finden sich die altesten Spuren dieses Herrschergeschlechts: malerische Burgen, Kloster und Ruinen.*Der Aufstieg der Habsburger von einer regionalen deutschen Herzogsfamilie aus dem heutigen Elsass zur machtigsten Herrscherdynastie Europas spiegelt sich auch in den vielen baulichen Zeugnissen wider, die heute noch an ihren Aufstieg und ihre einstige Macht erinnern. Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise in jene Lander und zu jenen Orten, die bis heute von den Habsburgern gepragt sind, ist die Wiener Hofburg. Ausgehend vom einstigen Machtzentrum der deutsch-romischen Kaiser fuhrt die Reise zunachst nach Westen, in das Elsass und den Schweizer Kanton Aargau, wo das Geschlecht der Habsburger vor rund 900 Jahren in das Licht der Geschichte tritt.Einen besonderen Stellenwert hat fur die Habsburger bis heute das Kloster Odilienberg im Elsass, wo die Reliquien der Heiligen Ottilie aus dem 7. Jahrhundert aufbewahrt werden. Den Habsburgern gilt die adelige Frau aus dem frankischen Geschlecht der Etichonen als Stammmutter ihrer Dynastie. Ebenfalls hoch uber dem Rheintal erhebt sich auch die Ruine der Burg Hohlandsbourg, die viele Jahrhunderte spater auf Befehl von Rudolf von Habsburg erbaut wurde. Sie zeugt vom beeindruckenden politischen Aufstieg der Habsburger zu einer deutschen Konigsdynastie im 13. Jahrhundert. Die Wahl Rudolfs zum deutschen Konig 1273 bedeutete einen enormen Zuwachs an Macht und Prestige, der sich auch in einer regen Bautatigkeit manifestierte.Ein Abstecher nach Suden fuhrt in den Schweizer Kanton Aargau, wo sich die Überreste der Habsburg erheben, die dem Geschlecht auch seinen Namen gegeben hat. Hier hat der Mittelalterarchaologe Peter Frey jahrelang zur Baugeschichte der Burg geforscht, von der nur mehr ein Teil erhalten ist.So wie Rudolf einst nach Osten, in das Herzogtum Österreich gezogen ist, um seinen Rivalen Ottokar von Bohmen zu besiegen, folgt der erste Teil der Dokumentationsreihe seinen Spuren nach Durnkrut, und damit an den Schauplatz einer der groSSten Schlachten des Mittelalters. Thematisiert wird auch die Bedeutung von Symbolen zur Festigung von Machtanspruchen und Status im Mittelalter. Im Dom von Speyer lieSS sich Rudolf I. neben den deutschen Konigen fruherer Adelsgeschlechter bestatten und untermauerte damit den neuen Status seiner Familie. Besucht wird auch die Schatzkammer in der Hofburg in Wien, wo seit rund 200 Jahren die Reichsinsignien Reichskrone, Schwert und Zepter aufbewahrt werden.Eine Dokumentation von Gernot Stadler

Send us your questions or experience by email to medical@orf.at or via WhatsApp at +43/1/87878-25614. / In Österreich ist in den vergangenen Wochen eine Debatte rund um das Thema Sterbehilfe entstanden. Rein rechtlich ist die assistierte Suizidhilfe seit Janner 2022 erlaubt, aktive Euthanasie - Totung auf Verlangen - ist verboten. Kritisch sehen die Regelung fur den assistierten Suizid vor allem die Kirche sowie die Hospiz- und Palliativeinrichtungen. Sie verfolgen vielmehr das Ziel PatientInnen mit lebensverkurzenden, nicht heilbaren Erkrankungen zu stabilisieren, sodass sie wieder etwas Zuversicht schopfen konnten.Aber reichen die bestehenden Palliativangebote aus, damit die Entscheidung frei getroffen werden kann? Und welche Rolle sollen Medien und Öffentlichkeit bei so sensiblen Einzelfallen spielen?Siegfried Meryn beantwortet Ihre Fragen zusammen mit Christine Fruhling, NÖ Patienten- und Pflegeanwaltschaft, in MERYN am Montag. Kurz vor ihrem Einsatz kommen sich Mace und Nick naher.Die Übergabe der Festplatte wird von der als Kellnerin getarnten BND-Agentin Marie Schmidt (Diane Kruger) torpediert, die Mace nach einer Verfolgungsjagd durch die Metro-Tunnel der franzosischen Hauptstadt entkommt - nur um dann festzustellen, dass Roja sie alle gelinkt hat und weiter im Besitz der Festplatte ist.Nick, der dem unmittelbar vom Übergabeort geflohenen Rojas instinktiv, aber erfolglos nachgehetzt war, findet sich hingegen unvermittelt mit dem britischen Kriminellen Elijah Clarke (Jason Flemyng) und einem bewaffneten Schlager in einer Sackgasse wieder. programme.title: Life on the German-German border / Leben an der deutsch-deutschen Grenze
programme.desc: Real wire and mines share Germany in East and West for 40 years - the death strip of the inner German border separates the country. He becomes a fate for many Germans. In film, they tell their experiences: including escape lodges and border guards - and two women from Magdeburg. They are the first GDR burger to drive on November 9, 1989 on the open border - near Helmstedt, before the wall falls in Berlin. The Germans in the western "zone edge area" are sometimes an occurrence of the border. A million tourists per year coil money into the pockets of the local economy, which also benefits from tax reliefs and investment allowances. On the GDR side, on the other hand, there is no way into the five kilometer wide "restricted zone" on the border without special ID. At night there is an outcome lock and a ban on assembly to make escape more difficult for the darkness. Today the former border is the "Grune Band": a unique nature reserve that is sniffing through the middle of Germany. / 40 Jahre teilen Stacheldraht und Minen Deutschland in Ost und West - trennt der Todesstreifen der Innerdeutschen Grenze das Land. Fur viele Deutsche wird er zum Schicksal.Im Film erzahlen sie ihre Erlebnisse: darunter Fluchtlinge und Grenzsoldaten - und zwei Frauen aus Magdeburg. Sie sind die ersten DDR-Burger, die am 9. November 1989 uber die geoffnete Grenze fahren - bei Helmstedt, bevor in Berlin die Mauer fallt.Fur die Deutschen im westlichen "Zonenrandgebiet" ist die Grenze zuweilen ein eintragliches Geschaft. Eine Million Touristen pro Jahr spulen Geld in die Taschen der einheimischen Wirtschaft, die auch von Steuererleichterungen und Investitionszulagen profitiert. Auf DDR-Seite hingegen fuhrt in die funf Kilometer breite "Sperrzone" an der Grenze ohne Sonderausweis kein Weg hinein oder heraus. In der Nacht gelten dort eine Ausgangssperre und ein Versammlungsverbot, um Fluchten im Schutze der Dunkelheit zu erschweren. Heute ist die ehemalige Grenze das "Grune Band": ein einzigartiges Naturschutzgebiet, das sich mitten durch Deutschland schlangelt.

programme.title: Anna and the apocalypse / Anna und die Apokalypse
programme.desc: A zombie epidemic breaks out worldwide on Christmas evening on Christmas Eve. And that is the school, of all people, where numerous parents and Schuler have gathered. In order to defend themselves against zombie snowman and penguins, they use unusual weapons. The Scottish director received attention on the former video platform Vine, among other things, when he published a number of short videos entitled "Ryan Gosling Wont Eat His Cereal" in 2013. At the age of only 27, Mchenry died of cancer in 2015. / Ausgerechnet am Weihnachtsvorabend bricht weltweit eine Zombie-Epidemie aus. programme.title: Motivation: what drives you? / Motivation: Was treibt dich an?
programme.desc: Alina Buschmann is disabled and handicapped after a car accident. She is anger over her situation and releases unexpected forces. Biologist Jasmina Neudecker asks: Can you use anger? Verprinted anger makes us body sick, but also uncontrolled anger, knows psychiatrist and neuroscientist Rene Hurlemann. The solution is to understand the anger as an alarm signal. It can be a compass for our needs and a protective shield. What makes us anger and what is the correct handling of it? To find out that, Jasmina Neudecker takes part in an anthroof seminar. Under the guidance of therapist Donata Oerke, she learns in practical exercises, her own strength to set traces, set limits and not to confuse aggression by violence. A revelation for Jasmina, who rather repress her anger. It sprints an energy that she has never noticed. After the car accident, she struggles through a "doctor-occurrence" and is confronted with pain, bureaucracy and existential worries. The anger that arises from it is impressive. But instead of breaking it, Alina learns to channel her. She found the "Angry Cripplles" internet platform to give herself and other affected people a voice. Her anger becomes a motor for social change. The journey shows that anger is a life energy. If we learn to feel and regulate them, we can use their tremendous creativity for ourselves. A pladoyer for the courage to anger. / Alina Buschmann ist nach einem Autounfall seh- und gehbehindert. Sie ist wutend uber ihre Situation und setzt ungeahnte Krafte frei. Biologin Jasmina Neudecker fragt: Kann man Wut nutzen?Unterdruckte Wut macht uns korperlich krank, unkontrollierte Wut aber auch, weiSS Psychiater und Neurowissenschaftler Rene Hurlemann. Die Losung liegt darin, die Wut als Alarmsignal zu verstehen. Sie kann ein Kompass fur unsere Bedurfnisse und ein Schutzschild sein.Was macht uns wutend und was ist der richtige Umgang damit? Um das herauszufinden, nimmt Jasmina Neudecker an einem Wutseminar teil. Unter Anleitung der Therapeutin Donata Oerke lernt sie in praktischen Übungen, die eigene Kraft zu spuren, Grenzen zu setzen und Aggression nicht mit Gewalt zu verwechseln. Fur Jasmina, die ihre Wut eher unterdruckt, eine Offenbarung. Sie spurt eine Energie, die sie so noch nie wahrgenommen hat.Alinas Geschichte zeigt die zerstorerische und zugleich schopferische Kraft der Wut. Nach dem Autounfall kampft sie sich durch eine "ÄrztInnen-Odyssee" und ist konfrontiert mit Schmerz, Burokratie und existenziellen Sorgen. Die Wut, die daraus entsteht, ist uberwaltigend. Doch anstatt daran zu zerbrechen, lernt Alina, sie zu kanalisieren. Sie grundet die Internetplattform "Angry Cripples", um sich und anderen Betroffenen eine Stimme zu geben. Ihre Wut wird zum Motor fur gesellschaftliche Veranderung.Die Reise zeigt: Wut ist eine Lebensenergie. Wenn wir lernen, sie zu fuhlen und zu regulieren, konnen wir ihre gewaltige Schaffenskraft fur uns nutzen. Ein Pladoyer fur den Mut zur Wut.

programme.desc: Czech Republic, review. With a start year in 1953, the FIA ​​European Rally Championship was held on asphalt and gravel. programme.title: Beauty UFC 313 / MMA UFC 313
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Cedevita Olympia - Mega / Košarka - ABA liga: Cedevita Olimpija - Mega
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Košarka - Aba League: Igokea - Fmp / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - FMP
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it also changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name of Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each, with each, one on the domestic terrain and one on the guest field, ie along the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoff differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Waterpolo - Regional League: Adriatic M: Tel - Partizan / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Jadran M:TEL - Partizan
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or Sponsor Name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which the falls of Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs, later and Italian and Serbian clubs are competing. The first season, which began on 26. September 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. For the year of the establishment, the same 2008 was taken in 2008. year when the decision was made in Dubrovnik in the European Championship qualification tournament. After the first season, the Leagues also joined the Italian representatives you soon gave up, while since 2014. the League counts and clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. Prva sezona, koja je počela 26. septembra 2008., okupljala je 12 klubova, 8 iz Hrvatske, 3 iz Crne Gore i 1 iz Slovenije. Za godinu osnutka se uzima ista ta 2008. godina kada je odluka donešena u Dubrovniku na kvalifikacionom turniru za Evropsko prvenstvo. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

programme.title: Alfred Dunhill Links Championship / Alfred Dunhill Links Championship
programme.desc: Follow the golf tournament that is played in Scotland since 2001. years. The Reward Fund Event is five million dollars, and in order to induce as much interest in the public, the organizers called on the tournament during the years, a number of celebrities such as Michael Douglas, Boris Beker and Jastin Timberlejsk. / Pratite golf turnir koji se igra u Škotskoj od 2001. godine. Nagradni fond događaja iznosi pet miliona dolara, a kako bi izazvali što veće interesovanje javnosti, organizatori su na turnir tokom godina pozivali brojne poznate ličnosti poput Majkla Daglasa, Borisa Bekera i Džastina Timberlejka.

programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Radnik - Široki Brijeg / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Široki Brijeg
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Fudbal - Danish Liga: Fredericia - Brondby / Fudbal - Danska liga: Fredericia - Brondby
programme.desc: Denmark Football League and its strongest Danish football rank is known as Super League and was founded in 1991. years. Club soccer has recorded their history since 1945. years and then 1. Division, which is the second football rank in Denmark and the League in which all clubs are not fully professional. The name of this competition changed through history depending on the sponsor. / Danska fudbalska liga i njen najjači danski fudbalski rang poznat je pod nazivom Superliga i osnovan je 1991. godine. Klupski fudbal beleži svoju istoriju još od 1945. godine i tadašnje 1. Divizije koja je danas drugi fudbalski rang u Danskoj i ligi u kojoj svi klubovi nisu u potpunosti profesionalni. Naziv ovog takmičenja se menjao kroz istoriju u zavisnosti od sponzora istog.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.
