programme.title: Football (M): Maribor - Domzale, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Maribor - Domzale, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: First League Telemach: Studio after Maribor - Domžale / Prva liga Telemach: Studio po Maribor - Domžale
programme.desc: You are invited to watch a sports show dedicated to the first Slovenian football league. We bring match analyzes, footage of the best moments and talks with football professionals. / Vabljeni k ogledu športne oddaje, posvečene Prvi slovenski nogometni ligi. Prinašamo analize tekem, posnetke najboljših trenutkov in pogovore z nogometnimi strokovnjaki.

programme.title: Nogomet (m): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): E Frankfurt - B. Munchen, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, which start matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Mussolini - fascist dictator, French documentary series, 2/2, Mon. / Mussolini – fašistični diktator, francoska dokumentarna serija, 2/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Mussolini, The Fascist Emperor / Mussolini, Le Premier Fasciste; Utelesil je zavezništvo med fašistično Italijo in nacistično Nemčijo ter zavladal ljudstvu kot novi cezar in dedič cesarskega Rima. Dokumentarna serija v dveh delih predstavi zgodbo o duče
programme.desc: Part 2: When Mussolini visited Hitler in Germany in 1937, he suggested that they divide Europe into two influential areas. Mussolini decided to enter a coalition with Germany. The German attack on Poland began 2. World War, in which Italy stradded more defeats than success. Due to internal tensions, Mussolini was dismissed by his party associates in 1943. He retreated to Lake Garda, where he unsuccessfully led the country for two years. Three days before Hitler's suicide, he tried to escape the German soldier, but was tried to escape to Tyrol, but was captured and killed by the partisans. / 2. del:Ko je Mussolini leta 1937 obiskal Hitlerja v Nemčiji, mu je ta predlagal, da si Evropo razdelita na dve vplivni območji. Mussolini se je odločil vstopiti v koalicijo z Nemčijo. Z nemškim napadom na Poljsko se je začela 2. svetovna vojna, v kateri pa je Italija nizala več porazov kakor uspehov. Zaradi notranjih napetosti so Mussolinija leta 1943 njegovi strankarski sodelavci odstavili z oblasti. Umaknil se je ob Gardsko jezero, kjer je še dve leti neuspešno vodil državo. Tri dni pred Hitlerjevim samomorom je duče, preoblečen v nemškega vojaka, skušal pobegniti na Tirolsko, a so ga partizani ujeli in usmrtili.MUSSOLINI, THE FASCIST EMPEROR / MUSSOLINI, LE PREMIER FASCISTE / Francija / 2021 / Režija: Serge de Sampigny.

From this house, the family was then moved to today's street. / Drago Senica-Pi je bil rojen v Mariboru pomladi leta 1934, v meščanski družini. programme.title: Dark cover of the world, documentary, Mon. / Temni pokrov sveta, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Amir Muratović... Izjemen letalec, fotograf, alpinist in okoljevarstvenik Matevž Lenarčič na svojih poteh okoli sveta z ultra-lahkim letalom zbira delce črnega ogljika, ki je drugi največji povzročitelj globalnega segrevanja.
programme.desc: A lonely adventurer often approaches the point from which there is no return. He had already flown in the northern course, the highest mountain of the world, landed in Antarctica, flew over the ocean sixteen hours without stopping, and surrounded the world three times by plane. With his friends Bogdan Biščak and Rad Fabjan, they climbed the first Yugoslavs on the Mite Mountain Fitz Roy and Cerro Torre. The travels made a deeper sense when he realized Grisha Močnik, who explores the influence of black carbon on climate and our lives. These tiny black particles remain in the atmosphere for a few weeks, penetrating our respiratory tract, blood and even to the brain. Due to air pollution with black carbon, seven million people die prematurely every year. In the Alps, the more and more conditional intrusions of desert sand, which promotes glacier melting. Grisha flies over the greenery islands to help improve climate models. It is taken across the Patagonian glaciers by Glaciologist Peter Skvarča, who witnessed the collapse of ice sheets in Antarctica. Through the endless Pacific Ocean, it reaches India. In this Himalayan country, they use gross domestic happiness instead of gross domestic product. We have come to the point where humanity will no longer have an impact on the increasingly common catastrophic natural catch. If we do not change our civilizational values, our world will establish a different balance, which will take millions of climate, economic and war refugees. The documentary film by Matevž Lenarčič, Amir Muratovic and Rada Likon was presented at numerous festivals and received the Iris Award for photography. The author of the music is Janez Dovč. / Samoten pustolovec se velikokrat približa točki, s katere ni vrnitve. Preletel je že severni tečaj, najvišjo goro sveta, pristal na Antarktiki, nad oceanom letel šestnajst ur brez postanka in trikrat z letalom obkrožil svet. S prijateljema Bogdanom Biščakom in Radom Fabjanom so kot prvi Jugoslovani splezali na mitski gori Fitz Roy in Cerro Torre.Matevževa potovanja so dobila globlji smisel, ko je spoznal Grišo Močnika, ki raziskuje vpliv črnega ogljika na podnebje in naša življenja. Ti drobni črni delci ostanejo v ozračju nekaj tednov, prodrejo v naša dihala, v kri in celo do možganov. Zaradi onesnaženosti zraka s črnim ogljikom vsako leto prezgodaj umre sedem milijonov ljudi.Lenarčiča pot vodi v Sarajevo, ki je med najbolj onesnaženimi mesti na svetu. V Alpah opazi čedalje pogo-stejše vdore puščavskega peska, ki pospešuje taljenje ledenikov. Z Grišo letita nad Zelenortskimi otoki, da bi pomagala izboljšati podnebne modele. Čez patagonske ledenike ga popelje glaciolog Peter Skvarča, ki je bil priča razpadu ledenih plošč na Antarktiki. Prek neskončnega Tihega oceana prileti do Indije.Za Matevža pa je najpomembnejša postaja na poti kraljevina Butan. V tej himalajski državici pri oceni na-predka namesto bruto domačega proizvoda za merilo uporabljajo bruto domačo srečo. Prišli smo do točke, ko človeštvo ne bo imelo več vpliva na vse pogostejše katastrofalne naravne ujme. Če ne bomo spremenili svojih civilizacijskih vrednot, bo naš svet vzpostavil drugačno ravnotežje, to pa bo pognalo na pot milijone podnebnih, ekonomskih in vojnih beguncev.Dokumentarni film Matevža Lenarčiča, Amirja Muratovića in Rada Likona je bil predstavljen že na števil-nih festivalih in je prejel nagrado IRIS za fotografijo. Avtor glasbe je Janez Dovč.

Za posladek pa bo ocvrto pecivo oreillettes.Jose Antonio bo za lovske prijatelje pripravil civet, golaž iz merjaščevega mesa, čebule in korenja, ki jih zalije s črnim vinom in vodo. Na koncu jed oplemeniti z omako pikado iz mandljev, temne čokolade, piškotov, česna in olja.

programme.desc: The EP-Album siren is based on exploring the stories of iconic women from different historical periods. These women were often overlooked, their voices silenced, and their destinies pushed to the brink of history. Thus, through our music, Raiven encourages us to look beyond the established narratives. Each song on the album represents a unique narrative that reflects the fight, strength and perseverance. The concert on the tenth anniversary also represents an opportunity for a retrospective view. Since the release of the first single of the 2014 sail, which was part of her debut Magent, all the way to the EP Rem, Raiven has created mystical and dark sound landscapes, for which she also received the prestigious professional award of the Golden Flute. Her performances at Emma, ​​especially with the songs black white, glow and chaos, fans still wear in her heart, and she left her mark at the Popevka Festival with the winning song Volkova in 2021. At the evening, where Raiven's passion of opera and the flashing rhythms of Electro-Popa combined the harmonious whole. / EP-album Sirene temelji na raziskovanju zgodb ikoničnih žensk iz različnih zgodovinskih obdobij. Te ženske so bile pogosto prezrte, njihovi glasovi utišani, njihove usode pa potisnjene na rob zgodovine. Raiven nas tako skozi svojo glasbo spodbuja, da pogledamo onkraj ustaljenih narativov. Vsaka skladba na albumu predstavlja edinstveno pripoved, ki odseva boj, moč in vztrajnost.Koncert ob deseti obletnici predstavlja tudi priložnost za retrospektivni pogled. Od izida prvega singla Jadra leta 2014, ki je bil del njenega prvenca Magenta, pa vse do EP-ja REM je Raiven ustvarjala mistične in temačne zvočne pokrajine, za katere je prejela tudi prestižno strokovno nagrado zlata piščal. Njene nastope na Emi, zlasti s skladbami Črno bel, Zažarim in KAOS, oboževalci še vedno nosijo v srcu, prav tako je svoj pečat pustila na festivalu Popevka z zmagovalno skladbo Volkovi leta 2021. Na večeru, kjer je Raiven strast opere in utripajoče ritmi elektro-popa združila v harmonično celoto ob spremljavi godal, seveda ni manjkala tudi evrovizijska uspešnica Veronika.

programme.desc: The film was made after the youth book hit by English writer Arthur Ransom with the same title. Four children dream of enriching their boring summer holidays. Mom eventually allows them to set up a camp on an islet in the middle of a big lake. They are happy, but it seems that they may not be quite alone ... in a "conflict" for dominance on a secluded island, they learn the skills of survival, but they also learn about the value and importance of friendship, and how important it is to always act collected and thoughtfully. The film was made in the beautiful environment of Lake District in England. Warm and heartfelt adventure that will enjoy the whole family. Explanatory title: Swallows and Amazons / British Film, 2016 / Director: Philippa Lowhorpe / Screenplay: Andrea Gibb / Actors: Kelly Macdonald, Andrew Scott, Rafa Spall, Harry Enfield, Jessica Hynes, Jesica Bremmer Henshaw. / Film je nastal po mladinski knjižni uspešnici angleškega pisatelja Arthurja Ransoma z enakim naslovom. Presrečni so, a vse kaže, da tam morda niso čisto sami … V »spopadu« za prevlado na samotnem otočku se naučijo veščin preživetja, spoznajo pa tudi vrednost in pomen prijateljstva ter to, kako pomembno je vedno ravnati zbrano in premišljeno. Film so posneli v prelepem okolju Lake Districta v Angliji. Topla in prisrčna pustolovščina, v kateri bo uživala vsa družina.Izvirni naslov: SWALLOWS AND AMAZONS / Britanski film, 2016 / Režija: Philippa Lowthorpe / Scenarij: Andrea Gibb / Igralci: Kelly Macdonald, Andrew Scott, Rafe Spall, Harry Enfield, Jessica Hynes, Richard Bremmer, John Henshaw.

In their spare time, they are increasingly devoting themselves to different activities, which brings them both physical and mental well -being. In Szeged (Seged), they paddle in dragon boats! Miles in the hinterland of Trieste are an old settlement in which the diverse history of the northernmost area of ​​the Adriatic Sea has been understood since the settlement of these places, and through national and political divisions to the present, in which the boundaries have become the past and the emergence of intercultural understanding. This could be the motto of Live Lavrinc, an untreated athlete who, in a mere four years despite a severe ordeal and disability, reached a sporting culmination at the Paris Parish Games, but did not even know the sport before. A bronze medal in doubles shooting is a great achievement, but the real joy for live is her family. Farmers are usually - usually in this profession, because their parents are also farmers. However, in Bavaria, more and more people are training for agriculture, although they do not come from the farm and cannot inherit it. What motivates them to learn this profession? / Šokantna statistika razkriva staranje madžarske družbe – čez dvajset let bo skoraj polovica prebivalstva dopolnila petdeset let! Vendar pa se starejši ljudje ne identificirajo več s klasično seniorsko vlogo, temveč prevzemajo novo. V prostem času se vse bolj posvečajo različnim dejavnostim, to pa jim prinaša tako fizično kot psihično dobro počutje. To bi lahko bil moto Žive Lavrinc, neugnane športnice, ki je v pičlih štirih letih kljub hudi preizkušnji in invalidnosti dosegla športni vrhunec na paralimpijskih igrah v Parizu, a tega športa poprej sploh ni poznala. Bronasta medalja v streljanju z lokom v dvojicah je imeniten dosežek, a pravo veselje za Živo je njena družina.Današnji kmetje se običajno -rodijo- v ta poklic, ker so tudi njihovi starši kmetje. programme.desc: Orlek has been considered one of the most original domestic ensembles for 35 years. We will also hear new stories from the album 3.5 full -fat at the unforgettable paradise from the concert to Kino Šiška. Guests at the concert are also Maja Predatoria and Vlado Kreslin. Na nepozabnem rajanju iz koncerta v Kino Šiška bomo slišali tudi nove zgodbe iz albuma 3,5 Polnomastno. programme.title: Albert's garden - shared waters / Il giardino di Albert - Acque condivise
programme.desc: All populations for centuries settled in the Alpine know that managing the water resource in an oculated and shared way is essential to be able to live and grow. The Vallesans of the Middle Ages also knew. Towards the thirteenth century they began to build an extraordinary network of channels, which collected glaciers' merger lacquares, to convey it to the valley and distribute it where there was a need. These channels are called "bisses" and today represent one historical testimony of hydraulic unhinestone made of common sense, audacity and pragmatism. Thanks to the bisses lagoraltura, viticulture and pastoralism Vallesane have been able to develop and thrive. People learned to share lacquets and manage them in an fair way. Unfortunately, by the end of the century, many glaciers are destined to disappear or at least reduce themselves drastically. What will be this network of channels? The water issue is crucial in the Canton Valais, already seriously affected by climate change. Between torrential rains, debrical flows, floods, late frosts, hailstorms and drought periods, the challenges are manifold and complex. The documentary proposed today by the Albert garden highlights these problems, reminding us that the management of water is not only an environmental, but also economic and social question. Faced with potential conflicts, the functioning of bisses - based on consortium management - could it represent a form of administration controlled by citizens for the sustainability of ecosystems? Between tourist, environmental, and socio -economic challenges, the Bisses Vallesani tell us a story that draws on ancestral knowledge to ferry them in about - ours - in which high -tech solutions may not be the only ones to offer us winning options. It is no coincidence that in 2023 the Bisses of the Valais entered the right to be part of the intangible heritage of the Unnesco. / Tutte le popolazioni da secoli insediate nellarco alpino sanno che gestire la risorsa idrica in maniera oculata e condivisa è fondamentale per poterci vivere e crescere. Lo sapevano anche i vallesani del Medioevo. Verso il XIII secolo iniziarono a costruire una straordinaria rete di canali, che raccoglieva lacqua di fusione dei ghiacciai, per convogliarla a valle e distribuirla dove vi era necessità. Questi canali sono chiamati "bisses" e rappresentano oggi uneccezionale testimonianza storica di uningegneria idraulica fatta di buon senso, audacia e pragmatismo. Grazie ai bisses lagricoltura, la viticoltura e la pastorizia vallesane hanno potuto svilupparsi e prosperare. La gente ha imparato a condividere lacqua e a gestirla in maniera equa. Purtroppo, entro la fine del secolo, molti ghiacciai sono destinati a scomparire o perlomeno a ridursi drasticamente. Che ne sarà di questa rete di canali? La questione idrica è cruciale nel Canton Vallese, già gravemente colpito dai cambiamenti climatici. Tra piogge torrenziali, colate detritiche, inondazioni, gelate tardive, grandinate e periodi di siccità, le sfide sono molteplici e complesse. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert mette in luce queste problematiche, ricordandoci che la gestione dellacqua non è soltanto una questione ambientale, ma anche economica e sociale. Di fronte a potenziali conflitti, il funzionamento dei bisses - basato sulla gestione consortile - potrebbe forse rappresentare una forma di amministrazione controllata dai cittadini per la sostenibilità degli ecosistemi? Tra sfide turistiche, ambientali, e socioeconomiche, i bisses vallesani ci raccontano una storia che attinge a saperi ancestrali per traghettarli in unepoca - la nostra - in cui le soluzioni high-tech potrebbero non essere le sole a offrirci delle opzioni vincenti. Non a caso nel 2023 i bisses del Vallese sono entrati di diritto a far parte del Patrimonio immateriale dellUmanità dellUNESCO.

Il Quebec si trova nella parte orientale del Canada, anche se Terranova e Labrador e le cosiddette "province marittime" (Nuovo Brunswick, Nuova Scozia, Isola del Principe Edoardo) sono ancora più ad est.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in her last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, which is often dealing with with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Sixth sense / Sixième sens
programme.desc: The superstar dhollywood, Bruce Willis, makes an impressive performance in this thrilling Thriller of Lecrivain-Ralister M. Night Shyamalan (nomine with the Oscars in the Categories of Best Original and Best Realizing Scenario) that criticisms qualify as moon of the best stories of ghosts ever filmed. When Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Willis), an eminent children's psychologist, meets Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment, the actor nomine in the Oscars in the Category of Best Actor in a supporting role), an eight -year -old child frightened and confused, he is not prepared to face the truth of what haunts Cole. Films with an intensity to give goosebumps, the discovery of Lincoyable Sixth Sense of Cole leads them in mysterious places with unforgettable consequences! / La superstar dHollywood, Bruce Willis, fait une impressionnante performance dans ce palpitant thriller de lecrivain-realisateur M. Night Shyamalan (nomine aux Oscars dans les categories de meilleur scenario original et de meilleur realisateur) que les critiques qualifient comme lune des meilleures histoires de fantômes jamais filmees. Quand le Dr Malcolm Crowe (Willis), un eminent psychologue pour enfants, rencontre Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment, l’acteur nomine aux Oscars dans la categorie de meilleur acteur dans un second rôle), un enfant de huit ans effraye et confus, il n’est pas prepare à faire face à la verite de ce qui hante Cole. Filme avec une intensite à donner la chair de poule, la decouverte de lincroyable sixième sens de Cole les conduit dans des lieux mysterieux aux consequences inoubliables!

Die Sangerin und Entertainerin Paola Felix wird am 5. Oktober 1950 in St. Gallen geboren. Überhaupt ist sie so etwas wie ein Gluckskind. Als Schlagersangerin ist sie ebenso erfolgreich wie als Komoderatorin der TV-Show «Verstehen Sie Spass?», an der Seite ihrer grossen Liebe Kurt Felix. Es ist eine Bilderbuchkarriere und eine Bilderbuchehe, bis Kurt Felix an Krebs erkrankt und schliesslich stirbt. In «Geboren am…» gibt Paola Felix Einblick in die Hohen und Tiefen ihrer Biografie. Wer oder was pragt unser Leben? Auch Catherine Leutenegger wird am 5. Oktober 1950 geboren, in Rom, wo der Vater bei der UNO arbeitet. Das Familienleben verlauft nicht ganz so harmonisch wie bei Familie Del Medico. Die Mutter erzieht die Tochter mit strenger Hand. Nach einer harten Internatszeit und einer Ausbildung zur Krankenschwester zieht es Catherine Leutenegger in die Ferne. Die altere Schwester des bekannten Unternehmers und FDP-Politikers Filippo Leutenegger lebt in Kuwait und Pakistan, bereist als Flugbegleiterin der Swissair die halbe Welt und findet ihre Bestimmung in der humanitaren Hilfe. Heute pflegt sie ihre grosse Leidenschaft: das Gartnern. Als Bub konnte er von der Fliegerei nur traumen: Doriano Dusci wird am 5. Oktober 1950 im Veltlin geboren. Seine Eltern arbeiten beide als Saisonniers in der Schweiz. Doriano wachst deshalb mehrheitlich bei seinen Grosseltern in Italien auf. Spater kommt der junge Doriano mit den Eltern in die Schweiz, macht eine Lehre als Mechaniker und findet eine Anstellung als Flugzeugmechaniker bei der Swissair. Der Traum vom Fliegen wird fur ihn wahr. Gleichzeitig erlebt er als Mitarbeiter die beiden schlimmsten Ereignisse in der Geschichte der Swissair mit: den Absturz der Swissair 111 in Halifax 1998 und schliesslich das Grounding der Fluggesellschaft.

Anna Giacometti, Nationalrat and former Community Prasident of Bregaglia, speaks over responsibility in the crisis, the reconstruction after the clash in Bondo and the challenges of the mountain regions. programme.title: Minisguard / Minisguard
programme.desc: In the museum you can admire all sorts of things and even touch: from ancient Rome sword or stone harness, but also newer things like one of the first vacuum cleaners or one of the first milking machines that have existed in Graubunden.Ronja has found the old cell phone of her grandmother and thought: Well, if that doesn't belong to the museum. Together with the museum director, Ronja also visits the underground depot, in which the museum kept over 100,000 objects well -used. / Im Museum kann man allerhand Sachen bestaunen und sogar anfassen: vom uralten Romerschwert oder Steingeschirr, aber auch neuere Sachen wie einer der ersten Staubsauger oder eine der ersten Melkmaschinen, die es in Graubunden gegeben hat.Ronja hat das alte Handy ihrer Grossmutter gefunden und sich gedacht: Na, wenn das nicht ins Museum gehort. Deshalb bringt sie das Handy zum Rhatischen Museum in Chur GR. Obwohl sie schnell einen Platz dafur in der Ausstellung gefunden hat, ist es ein langer Weg, bis das alte Handy wirklich ausgestellt werden darf. programme.title: Contrasts / Cuntrasts
programme.desc: Nino Schurter wants to achieve great things in the Mountain Bike World Cup last year. At almost 40, he stands up to everyday hard professional life and is skipping his body-knowing that many opponents are young for up to two decades and wins are less common. You also experience Nino Schurter privately and learn how he ticks as a person and father and how his environment, his parents, have shaped him. Is Nino Schurter succeeds in a career final point to measure-and how can he let go of this profile life that he lived for around 25 years? / Nino Schurter will in seinem letzten Jahr im Mountainbike-Weltcup noch einmal Grosses erreichen. Mit fast 40 stellt er sich noch einmal dem harten Profi-Alltag, schindet seinen Korper – im Wissen, dass viele Gegner bis zu zwei Jahrzehnte junger sind und Siege seltener werden. Der Film begleitet die Mountainbike-Legende vom Saisonauftakt beim Cape Epic in Sudafrika uber die Weltmeisterschaften im Wallis bis zu seinem allerletzten Weltcup-Start zu Hause in Lenzerheide GR.Schurter gibt nochmals alles, um sich den Traum vom Heimsieg zu erfullen. programme.title: Free to Run / Free to Run
programme.desc: Whether in the streets of New York or in the Swiss mountains, millions of runners around the world compete in national and international running competitions every year. But in the 1960s, running was an exclusive sport mostly reserved for men. Race was unhealthy, and those who jogged were referred to as a freak. On men who ran, they showed their fingers as soon as they left the stadiums and ran in nature. But the situation was even more radical for women: they were excluded from all of the run over 800 meters, since one believed that women were not graceful and a racing woman was simply not already looking at. In 1967, on the other hand, the ongoing women became a decisive year. During the race, she is recognized as a woman and the then race director is trying to drag her out of the barrel, which is prevented by her fiance in a spectacular way. Like a shock wave, the pressing picture of this interaction all over the world draws attention to the situation of women in general and in running in particular, and Kathrine Switzer himself becomes the icon of the struggle for equality of the woman. The director Pierre Morath is raising the incredible story of a bubble marginal sport, which has become a universal passion. A tribute to the freedom of running and to all those who did this. / Ob in den Strassen New Yorks oder in den Schweizer Bergen, jedes Jahr messen sich Millionen von Lauferinnen und Laufern auf der ganzen Welt an nationalen und internationalen Laufwettbewerben. Doch noch in den 1960er-Jahren war das Laufen eine exklusive, zumeist Mannern vorbehaltene Sportart. Rennen war ungesund, und wer joggte, wurde als Freak bezeichnet.Auf Manner, die liefen, zeigte man mit dem Finger, sobald diese die Stadien verliessen und in der Natur rannten. Aber fur die Frauen war die Situation noch viel radikaler: Sie waren von allen Laufen uber 800 Meter ausgeschlossen, da man der Meinung war, dass Frauen korperlich dazu nicht fahig seien und eine rennende Frau einfach nicht schon anzusehen sei. 1967 wird fur die laufenden Frauen hingegen ein entscheidendes Jahr.Kathrine Switzer schreibt sich fur den Boston-Marathon ein und bestreitet diesen illegal. Wahrend des Rennens wird sie als Frau erkannt und der damalige Renndirektor versucht, sie gewaltsam aus dem Lauf zu zerren, was von ihrem Verlobten auf spektakulare Art und Weise verhindert wird. Wie eine Schockwelle macht das Pressebild dieses Zusammenpralls auf der ganzen Welt auf die Situation der Frauen im Allgemeinen und im Laufsport im Speziellen aufmerksam, und Kathrine Switzer selbst wird zur Ikone des Kampfs fur Gleichberechtigung der Frau.Der Regisseur Pierre Morath erzahlt die unglaubliche Geschichte einer belachelten Randsportart, die zur universellen Passion wurde. Eine Hommage an die Freiheit des Laufens und an all jene, die dies erst moglich gemacht haben.

programme.title: In Teufels Kuche with Gordon Ramsay / In Teufels Kuche mit Gordon Ramsay
programme.desc: This time Gordon is to help two friends who belong to the French bistro Hannah and Masons. Both experience and passion lack both the new owners and the young manager. Will Gordon still succeed in penetrating the lazy owners of Hannah and Mason, or will he let their dreams burst? / Diesmal soll Gordon zwei Freunden helfen, denen das franzosische Bistro Hannah und Masons gehort. Sowohl den neuen Eigentumern als auch dem jungen Manager fehlt es sowohl an Erfahrung als auch an Leidenschaft. Wird es Gordon doch noch gelingen, zu den faulen Eigentumern des Hannah und Masons durchzudringen, oder wird er ihre Traume platzen lassen?

programme.title: In Teufels Kuche with Gordon Ramsay / In Teufels Kuche mit Gordon Ramsay
programme.desc: The Jacks Waterfront restaurant, which belongs to three bodybuilders, is actually a popular meeting point for water sports enthusiasts during the summer months. However, due to the medium -sized quality of the food and a lack of management, the restaurant slips on the bankruptcy. Can Gordon Ramsay help the three before the business accelerator sailed the company? / Das Lokal Jacks Waterfront, das drei Bodybuildern gehort, ist wahrend der Sommermonate eigentlich ein beliebter Treffpunkt fur Wassersportler. Doch aufgrund der mittelmassigen Qualitat des Essens und einem fehlenden Management, schlittert das Restaurant auf die Pleite zu. Kann Gordon Ramsay den drei helfen, bevor der Geschaftsfuhrer den Betrieb versankt hat?

programme.title: In Teufels Kuche with Gordon Ramsay / In Teufels Kuche mit Gordon Ramsay
programme.desc: Sammy, the owner of the Sabatiessel is highly indebted and hopes for a revival of the business from Gordon's visit. In an article, Sammy's heated temperament and poor service are explicitly highlighted, which does not promise anything good for the family restaurant. Sammy Gerat completely out of control. Can Gordon calm him down again or is everything too late? / Sammy, der Eigentumer des Sabatiellos ist hochverschuldet und erhofft sich von Gordons Besuch eine Belebung des Geschaftes. In einem Artikel wird explizit Sammys hitziges Temperament und der schlechte Service hervorgehoben, was nichts Gutes fur das Familienrestaurant verheisst. Sammy gerat vollig ausser Kontrolle. Kann Gordon ihn wieder beruhigen oder ist bereits alles zu spat?

programme.title: In Teufels Kuche with Gordon Ramsay / In Teufels Kuche mit Gordon Ramsay
programme.desc: Gordon visits the Mexican local Fiesta Sunrise. Yolanda and her daughter Patti hope that a serious word of Gordon will be able to get the Nuchtern and thick -headed Vic to the bottom of the facts. But when Gordon comes, everything is much worse and more unsanitary than expected. Does the sun for the Fiesta Sunrise always go under? / Gordon besucht das mexikanische Lokal Fiesta Sunrise. Yolanda und ihre Tochter Patti hoffen, dass ein ernstes Wort von Gordon genugt, um den nuchternen und dickkopfigen Vic auf den Boden der Tatsachen zuruckzuholen. Aber als Gordon kommt, ist alles noch viel schlimmer und unhygienischer als gedacht. Geht die Sonne fur das Fiesta Sunrise fur immer unter?

programme.title: In Teufels Kuche with Gordon Ramsay / In Teufels Kuche mit Gordon Ramsay
programme.desc: The Sante La Brea restaurant woins itself for its healthy food and a pleasant ambience. However, Gordon finds the exact opposite. Different food and a workforce that is not behind her boss Dean. The police also appear suddenly to make matters worse. And everyone lacks the words when they experience the reason for the visit. / Das Restaurant Sante La Brea ruhmt sich selbst fur sein gesundes Essen und ein angenehmes Ambiente. Gordon findet jedoch das genaue Gegenteil vor. Verdorbenes Essen und eine Belegschaft, die nicht hinter ihrem Chef Dean steht. Plotzlich taucht zu allem Überfluss auch noch die Polizei auf. Und allen fehlen die Worte, als sie den Grund fur den Besuch erfahren.

programme.title: Dating without limits: in 90 days to the altar / Dating ohne Grenzen: In 90 Tagen zum Altar
programme.desc: Evelyn and David close peace again. Elizabeth travels to Miami to her bachelor party. David introduces Annie to his children. Molly makes a difficult decision. Nicole and Azan say goodbye to Morocco. And Josh and Aika seek a fertility doctor. / Evelyn und David schliessen wieder Frieden. Elizabeth reist zu ihrer Junggesellenparty nach Miami. David stellt Annie seinen Kindern vor. Molly trifft eine schwierige Entscheidung. Nicole und Azan verabschieden sich in Marokko. Und Josh und Aika suchen einen Fruchtbarkeitsarzt auf.

programme.title: Dating without limits: in 90 days to the altar / Dating ohne Grenzen: In 90 Tagen zum Altar
programme.desc: Molly shocked her family when she betrayed Luis married. David Ladt Ashley entered his wedding, but will she appear? Nicole gets an update over Azan's visa application. The wedding day of Evelyn, David, Elizabeth and Andrei has come. / Molly schockiert ihre Familie, als sie verrat, dass sie Luis geheiratet hat. David ladt Ashley zu seiner Hochzeit ein, aber wird sie auftauchen? Nicole bekommt ein Update uber Azans Visumantrag. Der Hochzeitstag von Evelyn, David, Elizabeth und Andrei ist gekommen.

programme.title: Dating without limits: Countdown for love / Dating ohne Grenzen: Countdown fur die Liebe
programme.desc: Gino is destroyed on the ground after Jasmine broke up with him. Because the Latina is the love of his life that he wanted to marry. On the other hand, the American is angry, after all, he did everything to make Jasmine happily. Riley and Violet went through a lot in Vietnam. After eternal quarrels and outbursts of anger, the 48-year-old put a private detective on his fiancé, which he now regretted. Is there still a chance for the unequal couple? Dempsey throws her concerns about on board in Scotland and now wants to get involved in a steady relationship with Statler. / Gino ist am Boden zerstort, nachdem Jasmine mit ihm Schluss gemacht hat. Denn die Latina ist die Liebe seines Lebens, die er heiraten wollte. Andererseits ist der Amerikaner sauer, schlieSSlich hat er alles getan, um Jasmine glucklich zu machen. In Vietnam haben Riley und Violet viel durchgemacht. Nach ewigen Streitereien und Wutausbruchen hat der 48-Jahrige einen Privatdetektiv auf seine Verlobte angesetzt, was er nun bereut. Gibt es noch eine Chance fur das ungleiche Paar? In Schottland wirft Dempsey ihre Bedenken uber Bord und will sich nun doch auf eine feste Beziehung mit Statler einlassen.

programme.title: Dating without limits - emigration for love / Dating ohne Grenzen - Auswandern fur die Liebe
programme.desc: According to the hurricane, the extent of destruction on Providencia is indescribable. Ellie and Victor do not know when the island is habitable again, but the 38-year-old wants to go there quickly. Ellie did not want to live between trumpels. Her plan to move to Colombia and to open a beach bar in paradise has burst. But she continues to dream of a future together. In Ethiopia, Biniyam is worried to lose his little son. Since the boy has a hernia, Ari wants to fly to the USA with him and let him operate there. Will the two ever come back? / Nach dem Hurrikan ist das AusmaSS der Zerstorung auf Providencia unbeschreiblich. Ellie und Victor wissen nicht, wann die Insel wieder bewohnbar ist, doch der 38-Jahrige will schnell dorthin zuruck. Ellie mochte aber nicht zwischen Trummern leben. Ihr Plan, nach Kolumbien zu ziehen und eine Strandbar im Paradies zu eroffnen, ist vorerst geplatzt. Doch sie traumt weiter von einer gemeinsamen Zukunft. In Äthiopien ist Biniyam voller Sorge, seinen kleinen Sohn zu verlieren. Da der Junge einen Leistenbruch hat, will Ari mit ihm in die USA fliegen und ihn dort operieren lassen. Werden die beiden je zuruckkommen?

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch / Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck has a breakdown, Sara is invited to park her motorhome on a family ranch. She meets two brother who couldn't be more different. Porter is young, strong and troubled to please everyone. Aiden is old, calm and loves work on the farm and with horses. The brother are immediately taken with Sara, and soon she develops Gefuhle for both. / Als ihr Truck eine Panne hat, wird Sara eingeladen, ihr Wohnmobil auf einer Familienranch zu parken. Sie lernt zwei Bruder kennen, die unterschiedlicher nicht sein konnten. Porter ist jung, stark und bemuht, es allen recht zu machen. Aiden ist alter, ruhig und liebt die Arbeit auf dem Bauernhof und mit Pferden. Die Bruder sind sofort von Sara angetan, und schon bald entwickelt sie Gefuhle fur beide.
